description:
**Implement Multi-User Profile System with Parental Controls**

Create a comprehensive user profile management system that supports multiple profiles per household, with administrative controls, PIN protection, and kid-safe content filtering. Profiles must sync across devices using platform-native account systems.

Requirements:

Profile Management:
- Allow admin/owner account to create, edit, and delete user profiles
- Support multiple profiles per household (recommend 4-6 profile limit)
- Each profile should have: name, avatar/icon, age rating preference, and profile type (adult/kid)
- Designate one profile as the primary admin with full management privileges

Authentication & Security:
- Implement PIN lock functionality for individual profiles (4-6 digit PIN)
- Require admin PIN to access profile management settings
- Allow optional PIN protection per profile
- Handle forgotten PIN recovery flow for admin account

Kids Mode:
- Create dedicated "Kids Mode" profile type that restricts content
- Filter movies and series to show only content tagged with kids/family genres
- Hide age-inappropriate content based on rating systems (G, PG, TV-Y, TV-Y7, etc.)
- Implement visual indicators distinguishing kids profiles (themed UI, colors, icons)
- Prevent kids profiles from accessing profile settings or switching to adult profiles without PIN

Cross-Device Synchronization:
- Sync profile data using Apple iCloud on iOS/tvOS/macOS devices
- Sync profile data using Google Account on Android devices
- Synchronize: profile list, names, avatars, PIN settings, viewing preferences, and watch history
- Handle offline mode gracefully with local caching and sync on reconnection
- Resolve sync conflicts when profiles are modified on multiple devices simultaneously

Technical Considerations:
- Design database schema for profiles with relationships to user accounts
- Implement platform-specific sync APIs (CloudKit for Apple, Google Drive API or Firebase for Android)
- Ensure profile switching is performant (< 1 second transition)
- Consider COPPA compliance for kids profiles (no data collection without parental consent)
- Add analytics to track profile usage patterns (with privacy considerations)

Testing Requirements:
- Test profile creation, editing, deletion flows
- Verify PIN protection prevents unauthorized access
- Confirm kids mode properly filters content across all categories
- Test sync functionality across multiple devices on same account
- Verify offline behavior and sync conflict resolution
- Test with edge cases: maximum profiles, special characters in names, rapid profile switching

---

**Acceptance Criteria:**

**Profile Management:**

1. Given an admin user is logged in, when they navigate to profile management, then they should see options to create, edit, and delete profiles with a displayed count showing current/maximum profiles (e.g., "3/6 profiles").

2. Given an admin creates a new profile, when they provide a name (1-30 characters), select an avatar from at least 10 options, choose age rating (All, 7+, 13+, 16+, 18+), and select profile type (adult/kid), then the profile should be created and appear in the profile list within 2 seconds.

3. Given 6 profiles already exist, when the admin attempts to create a 7th profile, then they should see an error message "Maximum profiles reached (6/6)" and the create button should be disabled.

4. Given an admin edits an existing profile, when they change any profile attributes (name, avatar, age rating, type), then the changes should save immediately and reflect across all active sessions within 5 seconds.

5. Given an admin deletes a profile, when they confirm the deletion, then the profile and all associated data (watch history, preferences) should be permanently removed and a confirmation message displayed.

6. Given the first account is created, when setup completes, then that profile should automatically be designated as the primary admin profile with a visible "Admin" badge.

**Authentication & Security:**

7. Given a user creates or edits a profile, when they enable PIN protection, then they must set a 4-6 digit numeric PIN with confirmation entry (must match).

8. Given a PIN-protected profile exists, when a user selects it, then they must enter the correct PIN before accessing the profile, with a maximum of 3 attempts before a 30-second lockout.

9. Given a user is accessing profile management settings, when they attempt to open the settings, then they must enter the admin PIN regardless of which profile is currently active.

10. Given an admin forgot their PIN, when they select "Forgot PIN", then they should verify their identity via email/SMS code and be able to reset their admin PIN.

11. Given an incorrect PIN is entered 3 times, when the 3rd failed attempt occurs, then the profile should lock for 30 seconds and display a countdown timer.

**Kids Mode:**

12. Given a profile is set to "Kids" type, when the profile is active, then only content rated G, PG, TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-G, and TV-PG should be visible in all browsing sections.

13. Given a Kids profile is active, when browsing content, then the UI should display kid-friendly visual indicators (bright colors, playful icons, simplified navigation) distinct from adult profiles.

14. Given a Kids profile user attempts to access profile settings, when they tap/click settings, then they should be blocked and see a message "Ask a parent to access settings" with no PIN entry option.

15. Given a Kids profile user attempts to switch to an adult profile, when they select another profile, then they must enter that profile's PIN (if protected) or admin PIN (if not protected).

16. Given content contains mixed age ratings, when displayed in Kids Mode, then any content with ratings above PG/TV-PG should be completely hidden from search results, recommendations, and category listings.

17. Given a Kids profile is active, when the user exits the app and returns, then the Kids Mode restrictions should persist without requiring re-authentication.

**Cross-Device Synchronization:**

18. Given profile changes are made on an iOS device, when the changes are saved, then they should sync to iCloud within 10 seconds and appear on other logged-in iOS/tvOS/macOS devices within 30 seconds.

19. Given profile changes are made on an Android device, when the changes are saved, then they should sync via Google Account within 10 seconds and appear on other logged-in Android devices within 30 seconds.

20. Given a device is offline, when profile changes are made, then changes should be cached locally and automatically sync when internet connection is restored.

21. Given the same profile is edited on two devices simultaneously, when both changes sync, then the system should resolve the conflict by keeping the most recent change (last-write-wins) and notify users of the conflict resolution.

22. Given a new device logs in with an existing account, when the app launches, then all existing profiles, avatars, PINs, and preferences should download and be available within 15 seconds.

23. Given watch history is updated on one device, when synchronization occurs, then the watch progress should update on all devices to within 5 seconds of the actual position.

**Performance & Technical:**

24. Given a user selects a different profile, when they confirm the switch, then the profile transition (including UI theme changes and content filtering) should complete in under 1 second.

25. Given 6 profiles exist with full data, when the profile selection screen loads, then all profile avatars and names should render within 500 milliseconds.

26. Given Kids profiles are in use, when analytics are collected, then no personally identifiable information should be stored and all data collection should comply with COPPA requirements.

**Edge Cases & Error Handling:**

27. Given a user enters special characters in profile name (emoji, accents, symbols), when they save, then the name should be stored correctly and display properly across all devices and platforms.

28. Given a user rapidly switches between profiles 10 times in 30 seconds, when each switch occurs, then the system should handle all switches without crashes, data loss, or UI freezing.

29. Given sync fails due to network error, when the failure occurs, then the user should see a notification "Sync failed - changes saved locally" and a retry option.

30. Given a profile is deleted on one device while being used on another, when the deletion syncs, then the active device should gracefully log out of that profile and redirect to profile selection with a message "This profile has been deleted."

31. Given profile data becomes corrupted, when the app detects corruption, then it should fall back to the last known good sync state and alert the admin with option to contact support.

32. Given the admin profile is accidentally deleted via API/database error, when this is detected at app launch, then the system should automatically promote the oldest remaining adult profile to admin status.

# Comprehensive Specification: Multi-User Profile System with Parental Controls

---

## 1. Problem Statement

Users want to share a single streaming account across multiple household members while maintaining personalized experiences and parental controls. Currently, there's a basic profile system without PIN protection, kids mode, age-based content filtering, or cross-device synchronization. Parents need reliable controls to restrict inappropriate content for children.

---

## 2. User Story

**As a** household admin/parent,  
**I want** to create and manage multiple user profiles with PIN protection and kids mode,  
**So that** each family member can have a personalized, age-appropriate streaming experience across all devices.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria

### Happy Path Scenarios

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|----------|-------|------|------|
| AC-1: Profile Creation | An admin is logged in with <6 profiles | They create a new profile with name, avatar, age rating, and type | Profile appears in list within 2 seconds with all attributes saved |
| AC-2: Profile Selection | User is on profile selector screen | They tap a non-PIN-protected profile | Profile switches and UI updates within 1 second |
| AC-3: Kids Mode Filtering | A Kids profile is active | User browses content | Only G, PG, TV-Y, TV-Y7, TV-G, TV-PG content is visible |
| AC-4: PIN Authentication | User selects PIN-protected profile | They enter correct 4-6 digit PIN | Profile unlocks and switches successfully |
| AC-5: Cross-Device Sync | Profile created on Device A | User opens app on Device B | Profile appears on Device B within 30 seconds |
| AC-6: Admin Management | Admin navigates to settings | They enter admin PIN | Full profile management options are available |

### Edge Cases

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|----------|-------|------|------|
| EC-1: Max Profiles | 6 profiles already exist | Admin tries to create 7th profile | Error "Maximum profiles reached (6/6)" displayed, create button disabled |
| EC-2: Special Characters | User creates profile with emoji/accents | They save the profile | Name displays correctly across all devices |
| EC-3: Rapid Switching | User switches profiles 10 times in 30 seconds | Each switch occurs | System handles all switches without crashes or data loss |
| EC-4: Offline Mode | Device is offline | User makes profile changes | Changes cached locally and sync when reconnected |
| EC-5: Sync Conflict | Same profile edited on two devices | Both sync | Last-write-wins applied with conflict notification |

### Error Handling

| Scenario | GIVEN | WHEN | THEN |
|----------|-------|------|------|
| EH-1: Wrong PIN | User enters incorrect PIN 3 times | 3rd failed attempt | 30-second lockout with countdown timer displayed |
| EH-2: Sync Failure | Network error during sync | Failure occurs | Toast "Sync failed - changes saved locally" with retry option |
| EH-3: Profile Deleted Remotely | Profile deleted on Device A while active on Device B | Sync occurs on B | Device B redirects to profile selector with message |
| EH-4: Data Corruption | Profile data becomes corrupted | App detects corruption | Falls back to last known good state with admin alert |
| EH-5: Admin Profile Deleted | Admin profile accidentally deleted via error | App detects at launch | Oldest remaining adult profile promoted to admin |

---

## 4. Technical Context

| Aspect | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Affected Files** | `src/contexts/ProfileContext.tsx` (new), `src/services/ProfileService.ts` (new), `src/services/ProfileSyncService.ts` (new), `src/screens/ProfilesScreen.tsx` (modify), `src/screens/ProfileSelectorScreen.tsx` (new), `src/screens/ProfileSettingsScreen.tsx` (new), `src/components/profile/*` (new), `src/hooks/useProfileFiltering.ts` (new), `src/types/profile.ts` (new) |
| **Dependencies** | `react-native-mmkv` (existing), `expo-secure-store` (PIN storage), `expo-crypto` (PIN hashing), `@react-native-community/netinfo` (existing), Platform APIs for sync |
| **Constraints** | PIN storage must use secure storage, content filtering < 100ms, profile switch < 1 second, max 6 profiles, COPPA compliance for kids data |
| **Patterns to Follow** | Context + Service pattern (like `ThemeContext`/`AccountService`), MMKV for local storage, Singleton services, TypeScript interfaces |

---

## 5. Non-Goals

- **Account-level authentication** - Uses existing Trakt/local auth system
- **Remote parental monitoring** - No dashboard for tracking kids' activity
- **Cross-platform sync (iOS ↔ Android)** - Sync only within same platform ecosystem
- **Profile pictures upload** - Avatar selection from predefined options only
- **Screen time limits** - No time-based restrictions
- **Content blocking by title** - Only age-rating based filtering
- **Two-factor authentication** - Simple PIN only
- **Biometric authentication** - PIN-only for MVP

---

## 6. Implementation Tasks

```tasks
## Phase 1: Foundation & Data Layer
- [ ] T001: Create profile types and interfaces | File: src/types/profile.ts
- [ ] T002: Implement ProfileService singleton for CRUD operations | File: src/services/ProfileService.ts
- [ ] T003: Add secure PIN storage utilities using expo-secure-store | File: src/services/PinService.ts
- [ ] T004: Create ProfileContext for global profile state management | File: src/contexts/ProfileContext.tsx
- [ ] T005: Add profile-related storage keys and migration logic | File: src/services/mmkvStorage.ts

## Phase 2: Profile Management UI
- [ ] T006: Build ProfileSelectorScreen with avatar grid and PIN modal | File: src/screens/ProfileSelectorScreen.tsx
- [ ] T007: Refactor ProfilesScreen for admin management with create/edit/delete | File: src/screens/ProfilesScreen.tsx
- [ ] T008: Create ProfileEditModal component for profile attributes | File: src/components/profile/ProfileEditModal.tsx
- [ ] T009: Build AvatarSelector component with 10+ avatar options | File: src/components/profile/AvatarSelector.tsx
- [ ] T010: Create PinEntryModal component with lockout logic | File: src/components/profile/PinEntryModal.tsx
- [ ] T011: Build PinSetupModal for creating/changing PINs | File: src/components/profile/PinSetupModal.tsx

## Phase 3: Kids Mode & Content Filtering
- [ ] T012: Create content filtering utility based on age ratings | File: src/utils/contentFilter.ts
- [ ] T013: Implement useProfileFiltering hook for content lists | File: src/hooks/useProfileFiltering.ts
- [ ] T014: Build KidsModeTheme with child-friendly colors and styling | File: src/styles/kidsModeTheme.ts
- [ ] T015: Create KidsModeWrapper component for UI restrictions | File: src/components/profile/KidsModeWrapper.tsx
- [ ] T016: Integrate content filtering into catalogService | File: src/services/catalogService.ts
- [ ] T017: Add kids mode indicators to navigation and headers | File: src/components/NuvioHeader.tsx

## Phase 4: Cross-Device Synchronization
- [ ] T018: Create ProfileSyncService with platform detection | File: src/services/ProfileSyncService.ts
- [ ] T019: Implement iOS iCloud sync adapter using CloudKit | File: src/services/sync/iCloudSyncAdapter.ts
- [ ] T020: Implement Android sync adapter using Google Account | File: src/services/sync/GoogleSyncAdapter.ts
- [ ] T021: Add offline queue and conflict resolution logic | File: src/services/sync/SyncQueueManager.ts
- [ ] T022: Create sync status indicators and error notifications | File: src/components/profile/SyncStatusIndicator.tsx

## Phase 5: Integration & Polish
- [ ] T023: Integrate ProfileContext into App.tsx provider hierarchy | File: App.tsx
- [ ] T024: Add profile switching to app navigation flow | File: src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx
- [ ] T025: Update SettingsScreen with profile management entry point | File: src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx
- [ ] T026: Add forgot PIN recovery flow with email verification | File: src/screens/ForgotPinScreen.tsx
- [ ] T027: Implement profile persistence across app restarts | File: src/hooks/useProfilePersistence.ts

## Phase 6: Testing & Verification
- [ ] T028: Create Playwright verification test for profile CRUD operations | File: tests/profile-verification.spec.ts
- [ ] T029: Test PIN protection and lockout functionality | File: tests/profile-verification.spec.ts
- [ ] T030: Verify kids mode content filtering | File: tests/profile-verification.spec.ts
- [ ] T031: Test edge cases and error handling | File: tests/profile-verification.spec.ts
- [ ] T032: Clean up verification test file | File: tests/profile-verification.spec.ts
```

---

## 7. Success Metrics

| Metric | Target | Measurement |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Profile switch time | < 1 second | Measure from tap to UI update |
| Profile list load time | < 500ms | Time to render 6 profiles with avatars |
| Content filter performance | < 100ms | Time to filter 1000 items |
| PIN entry attempts | Max 3 before lockout | Implement counter with 30s timeout |
| Sync latency (same platform) | < 30 seconds | Time from save to appear on second device |
| Offline queue processing | 100% sync on reconnect | All queued changes sync successfully |
| Profile count enforcement | Exactly 6 max | Prevent 7th profile creation |
| Kids mode content accuracy | 100% age-appropriate | Zero adult content visible in kids mode |

---

## 8. Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|------------|
| PIN brute-force attacks | High | Medium | Exponential backoff lockout (30s → 1min → 5min), secure hash storage |
| Sync conflicts causing data loss | High | Medium | Last-write-wins with conflict notification, local backup before sync |
| Platform sync API limitations | Medium | Medium | Abstract sync layer with fallback to local-only mode |
| Kids bypassing restrictions | High | Low | No PIN entry option on kids profiles, admin PIN required for any settings |
| Performance degradation with filtering | Medium | Low | Memoize filtered content, lazy load filtered lists |
| COPPA compliance violations | High | Low | No PII collection for kids profiles, analytics opt-out by default |
| Profile corruption on crash | Medium | Low | Transaction-based saves, integrity checks on load |
| Memory issues with multiple profiles | Medium | Low | Lazy load profile data, cache active profile only |

---
